rubric.0: Absent/unverified or primarily outline for this check
rubric.1: Meaningful evidence with identified essential scoped gap
rubric.2: Substantial reviewed evidence meets this scoped check

score_semantics: Criterion score=100*sum(four marks)/8. Weighted readiness follows mandated weights. Marks are qualitative reviewer judgments grounded in listed paths, not measured field-knowledge coverage. Remaining%=100-readiness. Equal weighting across declared domain cards; overlapping book/project scopes make this an administrative readiness index, not a learner skill score.
selection_rule: Continuous mandate: readiness descending, then credible effort, mandatory gaps and prerequisite/tool availability. Close feasible near-STRONG domains without a decision pause; then earliest unfinished learner prerequisite. Frozen scopes/denominator remain unchanged.
algorithm_status_boundary: Foundational-release STRONG is preserved and freshly validated. Original full algorithms mandate stays PARTIAL; no substantial expansion without regression.
original_completion_metric: Conservative verified full-domain EXCELLENT closures divided by declared original-domain gates. This lower bound can be0 despite substantial developed units; no guessed effort-completion percentage substituted.
